newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PORC FLES RETURNS TO PROFIT IN H1.
newsitem.headline: PORC FLES RETURNS TO PROFIT IN H1.

text.p: (in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated)
Note - Porcelain and pottery maker Porcelyne Fles said in
April said it expected to return to net profit in 1996.
The company said in a statement on Wednesday it expected to
end the second 1996 half in profit, although performance in the
second half was traditionally weaker than in the first.
"Under unchanged macro-economic conditions there is reason
to believe that the second half of 1996 will also show a
positive result," Porcelyne Fles said in a statement.
It said revenues from factory tours had been boosted by
celebrations marking the 750th anniversary of the founding of
Delft and the Vermeer exhibition in The Hague.
Although picking up, sales in the glass, porcelain and
pottery sector were still a cause for concern, it said.
